data.title: Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking Supports CIP in $510 Million Project Financing in Mexico
data.description: Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking (Natixis CIB) announced on August 7, 2026, that they are assisting Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) with their Growth Markets Funds II (GMF II) project. data.title: Resolution Copper awards $110 million in US contracts to advance underground mine
data.description: In Superior, Arizona on August 7, 2026, Resolution Copper has granted contracts totaling around $110 million to Major Drilling America Inc. and Redpath USA Corporation. The contracts aim to accelerate exploration and underground development efforts at the potential Resolution Copper mine site located in Arizona. This significant investment underscores the commitment to advancing the project and the substantial financial backing allocated towards its progression.

data.title: City of Vallejo Retaliated Against Female Fire Captain; Parties Settle for $5 Million Before Damages Phase
data.description: Ratner Molineaux, LLP and The Law Office of Christina Giorgio, P.C. have successfully obtained a retaliation verdict and settlement for Melisse Leitzke, a former Fire Captain. Leitzke accused the City of retaliating against her following her report of gender discrimination at the Vallejo Fire Department in WALNUT CREEK. The compensation amount secured for Leitzke remains undisclosed.

data.title: HelloNation Features HVAC Expert Darryl Johnson on What Causes Air Conditioners to Blow Warm Air
data.description: In Connecticut, during the summer heat waves, various factors such as refrigerant problems, airflow blockages, and frozen coils can lead to decreased cooling efficiency in air conditioning systems. This issue was particularly evident in Danbury on August 7, 2026 as reported by PRNewswire. The article questions the reasons behind air conditioners occasionally blowing warm air during such extreme weather conditions, shedding light on the challenges faced by HelloNation in ensuring optimal cooling performance for residents.
